title: FeverDiff AI
description: AI-powered differential diagnosis assistant for malaria, dengue, chikungunya, and typhoid in Ghana.

details.problem: In Ghana, overlapping fever symptoms between malaria, dengue, chikungunya, and typhoid lead to dangerous misdiagnosis. Rural clinics lack specialist support for differential diagnosis.
details.fullOverview: FeverDiff AI is a clinical decision-support tool designed specifically for Ghana's resource-limited healthcare settings. It uses fine-tuned MedGemma 1.5 with a hybrid AI approach combining LLM reasoning and deterministic clinical rules.

features.title: MedGemma 1.5 & Gemini Reasoning
features.description: Core clinical reasoning powered by specialized medical LLMs for structured diagnosis.

features.title: Ghana-Specific Scoring
features.description: Tailored logic reflecting regional epidemiological patterns and seasonal disease weighting.

features.title: Researcher Workspace
features.description: Direct JSON import for rapid test scenario validation and pre-defined clinical test cases.

workflow: Patient data entry of 26+ clinical variables
MedGemma handles initial inference
Deterministic Clinical Rule Integration (CRI) validates results
Co-infection alert triggered if probabilities are statistically indistinguishable

roadmap.task: Deploy to Modal with GPU caching

details.architecture: Serverless backend on Modal Labs using GPU T4 for fast inference ( < 2s). Volume caching ensures model weights remain warm.
details.projectStructure:
├── modal_backend.py (Inference Logic)
├── model.py (Clinical Rules)
├── static/ (High-fidelity UI)
└── test_scenarios.json
details.disclaimer: FeverDiff AI is a decision-support tool and NOT a replacement for professional medical diagnosis. Always consult qualified healthcare professionals.

title: EpiScope
description: AI-driven platform for monitoring and predicting disease outbreaks using machine learning and RAG.

details.problem: Predicting disease distribution and understanding the 'why' behind outbreaks is difficult for healthcare decision-makers without specialized tools.
details.fullOverview: EpiScope enables hospitals to predict disease risk based on patient data, explore historical trends through dynamic visualizations, and understand predictions via SHAP explainability.

features.title: XGBoost Prediction
features.description: High-accuracy prediction for target diseases like Malaria and Diabetes.

features.title: Interactive Dashboards
features.description: Dynamic exploration of Ghanian health hotspots using Plotly/Dash.

features.title: Model Explainability (SHAP)
features.description: Visualizes exactly which features influenced a specific prediction.

workflow: Clinician enters patient demographics and symptoms
XGBoost calculates probability score
SHAP generates feature importance graphs
Gemini provides a plain-English summary of the case
details.architecture: Hybrid AI architecture combining deterministic ML (XGBoost) with Generative AI (Gemini) for both precision and interpretation.
details.projectStructure:
├── epi_app/ (Django App)
├── models/ (Serialized ML models)
├── dashboards/ (Plotly graphs)
└── templates/ (Frontend views)

title: QuickQR
description: File sharing platform with instant QR code generation and real-time view tracking.

details.problem: Sharing local files instantly with mobile devices during meetings or presentations is often cumbersome and lacks tracking.
details.fullOverview: QuickQR is a focused utility that converts files into instantly scannable and trackable assets using QR codes and Firebase persistence.

features.title: Instant QR Generation
features.description: QR codes link directly to file shareable URLs for immediate mobile access.

features.title: View Tracking
features.description: Real-time analytics on how many times each QR code has been scanned.

features.title: Secure Dashboard
features.description: Managed authentication where users only access their own uploads.

workflow: User uploads file to secure storage
System generates unique scannable QR code
Analytic service tracks 'visits' on redirect
User monitors scans in the admin panel
details.security: Firebase Security Rules enforced per-user; NextAuth handles session integrity.
details.projectStructure:
├── app/admin/ (Management UI)
├── app/[id]/ (QR Redirect logic)
└── components/ (Upload controls)

title: Polling App
description: Real-time shareable polls with instant QR codes and live results visualization.

details.problem: Collecting fast, low-friction audience feedback during events often lacks real-time visualization and easy sharing.
details.fullOverview: A high-performance polling application leveraging Next.js Server Actions and Supabase Realtime for a seamless voting experience.

features.title: Real-time Voting
features.description: Poll results update instantly across all connected clients without page refreshes.

features.title: Result Visualization
features.description: Beautiful charts powered by Chart.js showing live vote distribution.

features.title: Role Management
features.description: Admin vs regular user permissions for poll moderation and creation.

workflow: Admin creates poll with multiple options
QR code shared with audience members
Users vote via single-click server actions
Real-time chart updates for all viewers
details.projectStructure:
├── app/polls/ (Voting UI)
├── app/api/polls/ (CRUD Endpoints)
└── lib/supabase.ts (Client Config)

title: MedForecast
description: An AI-powered health prediction system that assists in identifying medical conditions based on symptom analysis and historical data.

details.problem: Medical conditions are often caught too late due to a lack of immediate, accessible diagnostic assistance. MedForecast aims to bridge this gap by providing early-stage insights based on clinical data.
details.fullOverview: MedForecast is a comprehensive health prediction platform designed to streamline the journey from symptom onset to diagnosis. By leveraging medical datasets, the application provides users with probable health conditions and trending health insights, while offering a robust admin panel for data management.

features.title: Health Prediction Model
features.description: Dynamic symptom-to-risk prediction using clinical datasets.

features.title: Medical History Tracking
features.description: Secure storage and retrieval of previous diagnostic results for patient monitoring.

features.title: Condition Explanations
features.description: AI-generated summaries of potential health conditions for better patient understanding.

features.title: Trending Diseases
features.description: Real-time updates on prevalent health conditions in the region.

workflow: User registration and secure login.
Completion of a dynamic health inquiry form.
Model processing of symptoms and historical data.
Generation of predicted diagnosis and accuracy metrics.
Storage of results in the user's medical history dashboard.

roadmap.task: Integration of advanced LLM for clinical reasoning
Mobile app companion for health tracking
API endpoints for external clinical integration

details.architecture: MedForecast follows a modular monolithic architecture using Flask as the central orchestrator and Supabase for high-performance data persistence and authentication.
details.projectStructure:
MEDFORECAST/
│
├── src/                # Core logic & prediction models
├── static/             # Assets and styling
├── templates/          # HTML views
├── views/              # Route handlers
└── app.py              # Application entry point
details.security: User data is protected via Supabase Auth and RLS (Row Level Security) to ensure medical histories are only accessible by authorized users.
details.disclaimer: This system provides predictions for informational purposes only and is not a substitute for professional clinical advice.

title: Hub Map GH
description: Ghana Tech Ecosystem Directory — The definitive community-maintained directory of co-working spaces, incubators, accelerators, and makerspaces.

details.problem: Finding verified tech hubs, co-working spaces, and accelerators in Ghana was previously a fragmented process with outdated information.
details.fullOverview: Hub Map GH is a community-driven platform that maps out the Ghanaian tech ecosystem. It features an AI-powered recommender that helps entrepreneurs find the perfect space using natural language, and an admin console for verifying crowd-sourced data.

features.title: AI Hub Matching
features.description: Natural language search for hubs using Google Gemini Pro for intelligent recommendations.

features.title: Interactive Ecosystem Map
features.description: Live mapping of hubs with Leaflet, providing a visual directory of tech spaces.

features.title: Admin Moderation
features.description: Secure dashboard to approve community submissions and manage ecosystem metadata.

features.title: Performance Optimization
features.description: Multi-layer caching achieving sub-50ms map loads for a seamless user experience.

workflow: Ecosystem exploration via interactive map.
AI-powered search for specific hub needs.
Community submission of new tech spaces.
Admin verification and live updates.
Fast retrieval via optimized caching layers.

roadmap.task: Global expansion for other African tech hubs

details.architecture: A modern serverless architecture utilizing Next.js App Router, with Firebase for real-time data and Gemini for AI intelligence.
details.projectStructure:
src/
├── app/ (Routes & Admin)
├── components/ (AI Recommender, Map)
├── context/ (Auth State)
└── lib/ (Firebase & Caching Logic)
details.security: Admin console is protected by Firebase Auth with IP-based AI usage limiting to prevent abuse.
details.disclaimer: This is a community-maintained project. Information is verified by the Hub Map GH team but subject to change.
